about: Chart data for the README. Versions and their descriptions are curated, as are known issues and the runs they affected; `npm run sts2:progress -- --add` lists new logged runs under their version, and `--refresh` updates run results and pace from the private run logs.
game: Slay the Spire 2, Ironclad, Ascension 0, standard runs (no run modifiers)

issues.label: Multi-hit attack intents such as "3x7 (21)" were not parsed, so incoming damage and survival forecasts were unknown on those turns.
The first plan of the run kept the previous run's potion reserve, which held potions back in hallway fights down to 1 HP.
The runner stalled for 12 minutes on a card transform screen whose preview kept changing; the run then continued where it stopped.
An event answer carried over to the event's later pages: at Abyssal Baths the runner chose Linger eight times, from 69 to 25 HP.
The game crashed during the Act 1 boss fight; the run resumed from the game's save 12 hours later, which restarted the fight.

notes: Beating the final boss on floor 48 wins the run. Early strategist versions reused seed JEV1 (v3.1 to v3.3 replayed v3's non-combat choices on it); from v3.5 on, every run uses a new seed.
The imported Jev the Spire policy reached the Act 3 boss once, in a Hextech Mayhem run. That modifier changes the game, so the run is not plotted. Runs still in progress are not plotted.
JEV20 (Strategist v3.16) was abandoned at Act 1 floor 3 when the code changed, and is left out.

pace.about: Median seconds between consecutive executed moves, including the Jev call. Gaps over 10 minutes (pauses) are left out.
